content.thinking: The big red 15,364 looks like tax, which worries me. The account is Psagot and the fund is Yelin Lapidot's S&P 500 tracker, but this page is too busy for me, so I'm stopping here.

input.answer: According to the page, the cheapest place is a securities account at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) with the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 fund. I'd put in 135,000 ₪ and have about 179,889 ₪ after 15 years, after fees and tax and "בכסף של היום". It counts prices rising by 2% a year and assumes the fund earns 7% a year.

stuck.why: It opens with English letters (S&P, MSCI) and the word מדד, and the background is dark. If I hadn't been given this task I would have felt it wasn't for me and left.
It says only "בכסף של היום" with no percent. I had to press the "אינפלציה" button to find the 2%.
There are many colours and numbers, with a big red-pink stripe of 15,364. It made me anxious and I didn't understand it.
